product_wide_rationale: Failed worker attempts remain terminal evidence, so retries require exact operator approval and fresh execution fencing without becoming typed restart.
summary: Failed retries below the three-attempt wall keep their pinned approval policy and fresh fencing; escalated retries require a single-use store-derived convergence basis. Oracle histories compare exact canonical ranked-finding sets with retained contract, job, owner, and byte-identical old control obligations plus supported closure evidence. Predicate IDs are not finding IDs. Oracle-defect closures, replacement findings, and recipe re-pins cannot mint shrink credit; accepted no_ship remains nonproductive. On repair-capable pins, CD-0205 D4 adds one named confirming-review admission at the wall, bound to the repairing acceptance and satisfied repairing revision, with no authoring attempt or restored admission after void. Historical pins retain their admission rules.
title: Failed worker retries require exact approval and fresh fencing
